description: Plays one round of a luck board for Luck Points, backing one outcome: commits to a hidden server seed, then settles with your client seed. Call get_luck_board first for the outcome index and the stake menu. Needs a key with "Play luck games (single player)" on. Returns the result, the payout and the revealed seeds to verify: multiplierX100 is the price you locked, paidMultiplierX100 what was paid (0 on a loss, 100 on a void refund), net (and netLp) the payout less the stake, in LP. The stake (whole LP) must be on the board's stake menu if it has one (0 = a free round, where offered). For invented games use play_invented_game; for rooms, join_room.

clientSeed.description: Your own seed, 1..64 chars (random if left out)

name: play_luck_board
title: Play a luck board
